checks.equipment: Fixed overhead suspension anchor, equal nonstretch straps and closed handles
checks.setup: 고정점을 바라보고 TRX 손잡이를 잡는다. 양발을 어깨너비로 벌리고 바닥에 고정한다.
checks.hands: Fixed closed neutral grips with constant strap length
checks.movement: 손잡이로 균형을 보조하면서 엉덩이를 뒤로 보내고 무릎을 굽힌다. 양발로 바닥을 밀어 일어난다.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; sampled clearance, not exhaustive mesh collision certification.
Rigid tensioned straps with simplified anchor support; no strap elasticity or load simulation.

checks.hands: Fixed closed neutral grips with constant strap length
checks.feet: Front foot flat and rear forefoot fixed

limitations: Procedural demonstration; sampled clearance, not exhaustive mesh collision certification.
